blocks.value: A beautiful gray tabby kitten, was born on May 15, 2026 (estimated) and has found her forever home!

Luna was found as part of a litter of four kittens in a cardboard 
box outside our shelter on June 20, 2025. After receiving 
excellent foster care from volunteer Sarah Martinez, Luna is 
now healthy, playful, and ready for her new life!

Luna brings joy wherever she goes. 
May you share many happy years together!

Emily Thompson 
789 Pine Street, Apt 4B 
Seattle, WA 98101

✓ First Vaccinations (June 25, 2026) 
✓ Deworming Treatment 
✓ Flea Prevention
